content.what_it_is: EFDC+ input pre-scan module (MODULE SCANINPMOD @L9): before the full INPUT phase, it scans every model input file on the master MPI process, broadcasts the scalar controls to all ranks, and derives the array dimension/maximum-record variables used for allocation. SCANEFDC (@L32-L868) walks EFDC.INP card by card via SEEK (C1 title through C91 netCDF card, close @L577): reads run controls (IS2TIM/IGRIDH/IGRIDV/KMINV/SGZHPDELTA C1A; restart flags C2; ISLTMT long-term mode rejected @L86-L88; momentum options ISCDMA with 1D-channel and experimental modes rejected @L107-L112; transport activation table ISTRAN/ISTOPT/ISADAC/ISFCT/ISCI/ISCO for NN = 0..8 C6; timing C7; grid size C9 with IC/JC/LC >= 3 checks and ICM/JCM/LCM = +1 dims @L161-L179; KC C9A with KC = ABS(KC) @L188; turbulence options C12A/C12B incl. ISGOTM/CHARNOCK; environment counts C14 (MTIDE/NWSER/NASER/ISGWIT/ISCHAN/ISWAVE/ISPERC/ISBODYF/ISPNHYDS/ISPROPWASH); open BC counts C16; constituent class counts and series counts C22 (NDYE/NTOX/NSED/NSND, NCSER1-7 returned as arguments, NSER(1:7) filled @L319-L325, TSSAL/TSTEM/TSDYE/TSSFL/TSTOX/TSSED/TSSND allocated @L311-L317); flow/hydraulic-structure counts C23; sediment card C36 setting KB/KBM and SEDZLJ detection (NSEDFLUME 98/99 => LSEDZLJ @L381-L388, legacy ISDTXBUG == 98 via C40 @L391-L405, bedload card C42A); toxics cards C43C/C44/C45A/C45E incl. PARTMIX trigger when PDIFTOXNT < 0 @L454 and TOXDEP dry/wet deposition flags; buoyancy/ice cards C46/C46A/C46D; drifters C67; time series output cards C84/C85; netCDF card C91), then scans VEGE/VEGSER (vegetation), DXDY (MHK device detection when 8th column > 90 @L653-L664, MHK.INP for MHKTYP), BEMAP/BESER (bank erosion), PARTMIX/TXDRY/TXWET (toxics), MAPPGEW/MAPPGNS (grid connectors), MODCHAN, and the WNDMAP/ATMMAP/ICEMAP multi-station weighting files with allocation of WNDWHT/ATMWHT/RICEWHT arrays (@L801-L856); read errors jump to labels 10/30 @L860-L866. The remaining subroutines scan one file each to size and allocate time-series structures (TS*.NREC/VAL/TIM zeroed): SCANMODC (MODCHAN.INP => NCHANM), SCANGWSR (GWSER.INP => NGWSER/NDGWSER), SCANASER (ASER.INP => TSATM, VAL(M,7); SUNDAY.INP when IWQSUN == 1), SCANSSER (SSER.INP => TSSAL), SCANTSER (TSER.INP => TSTEM; ISER.INP => TSICE when ISICE == 1, ISTAT.INP when ISICE == 2, VAL(M,1) = thickness, VAL(M,2) = cover), SCANDSER (DSER.INP => TSDYE per NDYE), SCANSFSR (SFSER.INP => TSSFL), SCANQSER (QSER.INP => TSFL), SCANWRSER (QWRS.INP => TSWR with NTMP constituents; parses wq_3dwc.jnp via fson for NALGAE/NZOOPL when ISTRAN(8) > 0), SCANPSER (PSER.INP => TSPS, VAL(M,2)), SCANWSER (WSER.INP => TSWND, VAL(M,2)), SCANQCTL (QCTL.INP => NDQCLT max rating-table points over ISTYP 0-3 table shapes). SCANWQ (@L1581-L2051) parses the JSON eutrophication configuration wq_3dwc.jnp via fson (kinetics option ISWQLVL, zone/lookup/output counts, point source option IWQPSL, NALGAE/NZOOPL/shellfish, NWQV = 19+NALGAE+NZOOPL @L1628), assigns constituent index constants for both WQSKE0 (ICHC..ICO2 = 1..22) and WQSKE1 (IROC..ICO2 = 1..19) layouts, builds WQCONSTIT names ('ROC'...'CO2', 'ALGn', 'ZOOn'), reads active_constituents flags into ISKINETICS, reads sediment-diagenesis and RPEM switches, per-constituent series counts NWQCSR, constant point sources (raising NCSERM), then wq_biota.jnp (mobility => ISMOB/NFIXED and ISTRWQ transport flags @L1875-L1895, hydro feedback => MACDRAG/ISVEG = 2, variable settling => IVARSETL), scans WQPSL.INP point-source series and the per-constituent concentration series files wqcsrNN/wqalgsrNN/wqzoosrNN (INQUIRE existence, count series into NSER(8), allocate TSWQ), and wq_3dsd.jnp diagenesis config (ISMICI/ISMZ/ISMRST/ISMHYST/ISMZB/ISMTS). SCANSEDZLJ (@L2054-L2094) reads BED.SDF for KB/ICALC_BL/SEDSTEP/SEDSTART/IHTSTRT/IMORPH/ISWNWAVE/MAXDEPLIMIT/HPMIN and ITBM/NSICM. SCNTXSED (@L2096-L2212) sizes TXSER/SDSER/SNSER concentration series into TSTOX/TSSED/TSSND. SCANPROPWASH (@L2214-L2237) reads propwash_config.jnp fast-settling parameters (fraction_fast, fast_multiplier). OPENFILE (@L2239-L2254) prints the scan banner, opens unit 1 with lower-cased name, STOPP on missing file; StrUpCase/StrLowCase (@L2256-L2292) are the case converters from Paul van Delst's String_Utility.

verbatim_spans.text: character( * ), PRIVATE, parameter :: LOWER_CASE = 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz'  !< Lowercase alphabet
ISVEG = 2                                   ! *** Gets overwritten in INPUT but used to flag allocation of vegetation arrays

unresolved: L25-L26: module-level 'character(*) :: STR*200' and 'CFILE*15' declare assumed-length characters with length specs but no parameter attribute - nonstandard Fortran; how the target compilers treat this is not resolvable in-file.

L904: SCANGWSR sizes each groundwater series record as 3+NDYE+NSED+NSND+NTOX values with in-line comment 'DELME - WQ' - WQ constituents are not part of the scan count; whether GWSER.INP may carry WQ columns is not resolvable here.

L1410-L1415 (SCANWRSER): error label 20 prints the read-error message but has no STOPP and falls through into label 40's 'UNEXPECTED END' message before stopping - the reported reason at label 20 is misleading.
L948, L997: SCANASER's loop variable is NA but its label-20 error message prints NS, which is never assigned in this subroutine - the series number in the error text is undefined.
L1902 vs L1904: file opened is 'WQPSL.INP' but ERRSTR reads 'READING WPQSL.INP' (transposed) - error text does not match the file name.
L2062-L2085 (SCANSEDZLJ): read errors are detected only by 'ERROR == 1'; other nonzero IOSTAT values (including negative end-of-file codes) bypass the handlers.
L1590, L1935-L1948: FNWQSR is dimensioned 40 and filled to index 19+NALGAE+NZOOPL with no bound check; behavior when NALGAE+NZOOPL > 21 is not resolvable in-file.
L811: inside the NWSER > 1 block, Broadcast_Scalar(NWSER, ...) re-broadcasts a value already broadcast at L226; whether this is defensive or vestigial is not stated.
